card.title: IPhone 11 Always Searching for Network IMEI Present

source.title: IPhone 11 Always Searching for Network IMEI Present

claims.statement: If an iPhone 11 shows its IMEI and modem firmware but is always searching, the baseband CPU and PMU are working; the fault lies in the RF path.
After splitting, check for ripped pads and compare diode readings around network chips; on the top board VFE_HI_3V15 is commonly shorted—inject 1 V and thermal-camera it.

procedure: Confirm IMEI and modem firmware present.
Split the board; check ripped pads.
Diode-check RF lines on both boards.
Inject 1 V into VFE_HI_3V15 and replace the hot part.
Test in iSocket, reball, test signal and calls.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
